Quick answers

Frequently asked questions

Can I request a delivery to or from Dukem?

Yes, you can send a request in either direction. Contact Mechet to confirm whether your exact route is currently available.

How much does delivery cost?

The fee depends on the route and the request. We will confirm the price with you before accepting the order.

How do I place an order on this website?

Complete the order form, choose one of the two WhatsApp numbers, and tap “Send Order on WhatsApp.” WhatsApp opens with your request ready; review it and tap Send. Mechet will confirm the route, fee and timing.

Can my cafe or shop work with Mechet?

Yes. Use the order form to select “Business partnership” and tell us about your business. Our team can discuss possible arrangements with you.
